title: Hamiltonian Matrix
description: Essential Criteria: The Hamiltonian matrix must be correctly constructed and expressed in terms of the constants and time-dependent magnetic field.

title: Spin State Evolution
description: Important Criteria: The time-dependent spin state must be derived correctly from the Schrödinger equation with appropriate initial conditions.

title: Probability Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The probability of measuring S_x = -hbar/2 must be accurately calculated from the evolved spin state.

title: Minimum Field Requirement
description: Essential Criteria: The condition for the minimum magnetic field required for a complete spin flip must be correctly stated and derived.

title: Initial Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The initial conditions for the spin state must be correctly identified and applied in the solution.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units in the calculations should be consistent and correctly applied throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the Hamiltonian should be avoided.
